§9FROM HERE ON YOU ARE BACK AMONG ITEMS YOU ALREADY KNOW.§r
Ceramic powder becomes a pellet, four pellets become a rod, three rods become a bundle.

§513-15. THE CERAMIC ROUTE§r
 §2 4x Ceramic UO2 Powder + grade circuit + 250 L Lubricant  ->  4x Green Pellet§r §8(Forming Press, MV)§r
 §2 4x Green Pellet + 1,000 L Hydrogen  ->  4x Sintered Pellet§r §8(Vacuum Furnace, 1,800 K, IV)§r
 §2 1x Sintered Pellet  ->  1x Fuel Pellet§r + grinding sludge at 10% §8(Lathe, MV)§r
  §8The hydrogen is not decoration - UO2 fired in air oxidises. Sludge goes back to powder 8-for-4 in a Dehydrator.§r

§516. THE CLADDING§r §8- Assembler, EV§r
 §2 2x Zircaloy-4 Plate + circuit 7 + 100 L Lubricant  ->  1x Cladding Tube§r
  §2Stainless Rod + Stainless Spring + Rhodium-Plated Palladium Plate + circuit 5  ->  1x Rod Hardware Set§r
 §2 2x Zircaloy-4 Plate + 4x Stainless Ring + circuit 6  ->  2x Grid Spacer§r
  §8Zircaloy-4 is GoodGenerator's, and it is the real alloy a PWR fuel rod is clad in.§r

§517-18. THE FUEL FABRICATION HALL§r §8- new multiblock, IV§r
 §2 4x Fuel Pellet + Cladding Tube + Rod Hardware Set + grade circuit + 100 L Helium  ->  1x FUEL ROD§r
 §2 3x Fuel Rod + 2x Grid Spacer + Iridium Plate + molten Platinum  ->  1x FUEL ASSEMBLY§r

§1Four pellets to a rod. Three rods to a bundle.§r

[note]§1Why a multiblock and not an Assembler?§r Throughput. A tier-5 silo eats§9 201 rods every 90-minute cycle§r, in up to four grades at once. The Hall runs§9 8 recipes in parallel per casing tier§r; an Assembler runs one.[/note]

§5THE OTHER THREE GRADES§r
  §9MOX§r §8x2 steam§r - 2x PuO2 co-milled into 30x Depleted UO2 in the §9IsaMill§r. That is§9 6.25% plutonium§r, which is what commercial MOX actually is, and the diluent is the cascade tails from §9Conversion and the Cascade§r, reconverted on The Water Step - §1which takes a water rung of its own§r.
  §9Thorium-Bonded§r §8x5§r - GoodGenerator's thorium oxalate WASHED and calcined to thoria on The Water Step - §1the third water rung§r - then co-milled with two parts uranium ceramic in the IsaMill. §8Thoria is fertile, not fissile: it needs a driver.§r
  §9Naquadah-Bonded§r §8x9§r - sintered pellets infiltrated with naquadah vapour in a Quantum Force Transformer at UHV, using the§9 200 L of highly enriched UF6§r from the Cascade Hall's high-enrichment branch. Rod on a §9Precise Assembler§r (casing tier 2, UV); bundle on the §9Assembly Line§r, scanned off a Thorium-Bonded Fuel Assembly and needing 4 Zircaloy-4 plates for the channel box on top of the usual spacers and iridium.
  §8Both IsaMill steps want an Alumina Milling Ball in the ball bus, exactly as the first milling step does.§r

[warn]The press and the sinter are grade-TAGGED items, not one shared pellet, and that is on purpose: a circuit cannot survive an item. One fungible green pellet would let plain uranium powder be pressed and sintered into MOX pellets with no plutonium anywhere in the line.[/warn]
